# Caldic

> Caldic is a global specialty chemicals distributor and partner for Life Science and Material Science industries across multiple regions.

Caldic operates across key markets including Asia-Pacific, Europe, North America, and the United States, providing supply chain solutions and specialty expertise to support customer growth. The company focuses on Life Science and Material Science sectors with regional operations led by experienced leadership.

## Key Topics

- Caldic
- Asia-Pacific (APAC)
- Life Science
- Material Science
- Specialty chemicals
- Regional operations
- Supply chain solutions
- Growth partnership
- Market expertise
- North America
- Europe
- Specialty solutions

- [Caldic in Asia-Pacific](https://www.caldic.com/en/regions/apac): Caldic's Asia-Pacific regional operations and specialty solutions for Life Science
